main_text.p:
dotem pacis.Habet gloria, ait Plinius, præ-Infocia-
bile.sertim in studijs, quiddam ἀκοινωνητον: Nolo in me expetat. & quandocumque moriar, feram mecum hanc conscientiam, nullius me famæ inuidisse, quosdam meæ. Quod si æuum hoc parum etiam gratum sit: quid noui? Suum cuique pretium posteritas rependet. Tu Lector vale, & juuantem, aut certè volentem, ama.

page.notes: The margin note reads "Infociabile." (printed in two lines, "Infocia-" / "bile."). The Greek word ἀκοινωνητον is as I read it and is uncertain [?]. The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed.
